test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 475 648 857 591 362 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

(NOTE: All operations to be done from left to right.)

If 1 is added to the third digit of every number, then how many numbers will become even?
solution:
The five numbers are: 475, 648, 857, 591, and 362.

Following the instruction to add 1 to the third digit of every number:**

 
• 475 becomes 476. The third digit is now 6, which is an even number.
 
• 648 becomes 649. The third digit is now 9, which is an odd number.
 
• 857 becomes 858. The third digit is now 8, which is an even number.
 
• 591 becomes 592. The third digit is now 2, which is an even number.
 
• 362 becomes 363. The third digit is now 3, which is an odd number.

A number is even if its last (third) digit is even. The numbers with an even third digit are 476, 858, and 592.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3"**
